LESSON: SELECTED VERSES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.4 Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) (4 lessons) By the end of
Topic 1.5: Selected verses
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected verses, part of Qur’an 1.4 Asbaabu an- Nuzuul (reasons for revelation) (4 lessons) By the end of in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How can a Muslim exemplify the qualities mentioned in the selected verses?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use a translated text of the Quran to extract the meaning of the selected verses in Surah al- Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)and make notes

2. listen to / watch an audio-visual clip from a digital device with assistive technology on the selected verses in Surah al- Furqan (Q. 25:61-77) and their corresponding meaning and make notes,

3. discuss the qualities of the servants of Allah as mentioned in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61- 77)in small groups and present in class,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use a translated text of the Quran to extract the meaning of the selected verses in Surah al- Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)and make notes
2. listen to / watch an audio-visual clip from a digital device with assistive technology on the selected verses in Surah al- Furqan (Q. 25:61-77) and their corresponding meaning and make notes,
3. discuss the qualities of the servants of Allah as mentioned in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61- 77)in small groups and present in class,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Selected verses together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the skills of interacting with technology and connecting using digital technology are enhanced as learners

search online for the meaning of the selected verses in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners dramatise the lessons learnt from the selected

verses in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)(humility in walking, moderation in spending, modesty in speech, non-beneficial

confrontation, bearing false witness)

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork are enhanced as learners

brainstorm on the teachings of the selected verses in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)in small groups and present in class

28

• Learning to Learn: the skill of working collaboratively is enhanced as learners dramatise the lessons learnt from

the selected verses in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)(humility in walking, moderate in spending, modesty in

speech, non-beneficial confrontation, bearing false witness)

• Citizenship: social and civic skills are enhanced as the learners dramatise the lessons learnt from the selected

verses in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)(humility in walking, moderate in spending, modesty in speech, non- beneficial confrontation, bearing false witness)

Values:
• Respect: etiquette enhanced as leaners tolerate each other’s opinions while discussing in small groups the qualities of the

servants of Allah (S.W.T.) as mentioned in Surah al-Furqan (Q. 25:61-77)and present in class

• Peace: responsibility is realised as learners dramatise the lessons learnt from the selected verses in Surah al-Furqan (Q.

25:61-77) (humility in walking, moderate in spending, modesty in speech, non-beneficial confrontation, bearing false

witness)

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life skills: self-management skill is realised as learners dramatise the lessons learnt from the selected verses in Surah al- Furqan (Q. 25:61-77) (humility in walking, moderation in spending, modesty in speech, non-beneficial confrontation,

bearing false witness, sexual morality)
